text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Rhein 
Kraft...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Look! It's Paka Petit. So cute.

Looking in the direction Rhein Kraft 
pointed, there was a claw crane machine 
filled with plushies in the likeness of 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I often make clothes for plushies, too~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I dress them up in original clothes and 
accessories. It's really a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I could never have too many 
plushies."
choice_data_list: Shall I get that for you?

text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
